text_markup: If the played card has an ability indicating that it is not trashed until a certain effect occurs, instead of trashing it, a lingering effect is created with a duration that expires as the indicated effect occurs. See also {ref:sec_lingering_effects}.
text_plain: If the played card has an ability indicating that it is not trashed until a certain effect occurs, instead of trashing it, a lingering effect is created with a duration that expires as the indicated effect occurs. See also section 9.10.
